taxonomy_bindings.definition: An independent review is a recorded assessment of a release by someone other than its author, completed before publication. Distinct identities alone do not prove independence.
taxonomy_bindings.source_reference: Local synthetic design exercise; no external taxonomy endorsement.

operational_test.population: Every production release published during the first three calendar months after rollout, including reverted releases.
operational_test.numerator: Count of releases lacking a pre-publication independent review record.
operational_test.denominator: All releases in the population; retain failed, reverted and disputed releases.
operational_test.measurement_method: Compare publication ledger with review records at the same day/time three calendar months after rollout. Empty cohorts yield no evidence of review coverage.
operational_test.data_source: Local release ledger and signed review records, not supplied by this example.
operational_test.missing_data_policy: Treat missing records as unverifiable and trigger review; never silently drop them.
operational_test.owner: Synthetic review council; appointment and authority require independent confirmation.
operational_test.fallback_action: Pause delegated publication until independent review and authorization to resume are recorded.
